The TGA-DTG data show components burned off the recovered NMC622: the organic coating layer, losing ~3.3 wt% loss at ~350 °C[1], and carbon black (CB), losing ~4.1 wt% loss at ~550 °C[2]. Calcining in air at 600 °C[3] removes both of them, as the text states.

Source: the TGA-DTG curves in the figure for the recovered NMC622.[4]Fig. 4[5]
